name: balloons
description: Competitive intelligence product (slices + reporting) — separate from warehouse (btw-wh-server)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @balloons/domain && npm run build -w @balloons/memory -w @balloons/browser && npm run build -w @balloons/slice-engine && npm run build -w @balloons/reporting && npm run build -w @balloons/web-api-client && npm run build -w @balloons/api --if-present && npm run build -w @balloons/web-slices --if-present && npm run build -w @balloons/web-analytics --if-present
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run
